verdict.rationale: Godot documents a scriptable editor surface: EditorInterface can save and reload scenes and inspect or edit resources and objects, and EditorScript, editor plugins and import plugins extend editor behavior. The documented command line and `--headless` mode support CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation. However, there is no official external control API or MCP server. An agent has to write GDScript and run it via the CLI or through a plugin, and live editor control depends on fragmented community MCP projects. Missing for 10: an official agent-facing or remote editor-control interface (e.g. an official MCP or RPC API), explicit evidence of creating nodes and setting properties programmatically, EditorScript runs only from the editor menu rather than headlessly in the evidence, and no hands-on corroboration of an agent driving the editor end to end.
